```sql
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        WEEKOFYEAR(start_date) start_date_weekofyear,
        CASE WHEN plan = 'premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_premium
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE start_date > DATE '2023-07-18'
),
cleaned_subscriptions AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(plan) plan_lower,
        INITCAP(TRIM(plan)) plan_title
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE customer_id IS NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(is_premium) OVER w_recent prev_is_premium,
        LAG(monthly_fee) OVER w_recent prev_monthly_fee,
        LEAD(monthly_fee) OVER w_recent next_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent event_seq,
        LAG(is_premium, 1) OVER w_recent_2 prev_is_premium_2
    FROM cleaned_subscriptions
    WHERE plan IN ('standard', 'premium', 'enterprise')
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY is_premium, id), w_recent_2 AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date_weekofyear, id)
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, next_monthly_fee + prev_is_premium_2 next_monthly_fee_plus_prev_is_premium_2
    FROM scored
    WHERE end_date > DATE '2023-09-20'
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.plan,
    s.end_date,
    s.monthly_fee,
    s.start_date_weekofyear,
    s.is_premium,
    s.prev_is_premium,
    s.event_seq,
    CASE WHEN plan RLIKE '^(basic|enterprise)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS plan_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(x.shipping_fee) FROM orders x WHERE x.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS max_order_shipping_fee
FROM base s
ORDER BY start_date_weekofyear NULLS LAST;
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("is_premium", "id")
w_recent_2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("start_date_weekofyear", "id")
shipping_fee_by_customer_id = df_orders.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.max("shipping_fee").alias("max_order_shipping_fee"))

cleaned = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("start_date") > F.lit("2023-07-18").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        F.weekofyear("start_date").alias("start_date_weekofyear"),
        F.when(F.col("plan") == "premium", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_premium"),
    )
)

cleaned_subscriptions = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNull())
    .withColumn("plan_lower", F.lower("plan"))
    .withColumn("plan_title", F.initcap(F.trim("plan")))
)

scored = (
    cleaned_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("plan").isin(["standard", "premium", "enterprise"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("is_premium").over(w_recent).alias("prev_is_premium"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
        F.lead("monthly_fee").over(w_recent).alias("next_monthly_fee"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("event_seq"),
        F.lag("is_premium", 1).over(w_recent_2).alias("prev_is_premium_2"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-09-20").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("next_monthly_fee") + F.col("prev_is_premium_2")).alias("next_monthly_fee_plus_prev_is_premium_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .join(shipping_fee_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "start_date_weekofyear",
        "is_premium",
        "prev_is_premium",
        "event_seq",
        F.when(F.col("plan").rlike("^(basic|enterprise)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("plan_zone"),
        F.col("max_order_shipping_fee"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("start_date_weekofyear").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

```sql
with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        coupon_codes,
        key,
        attr_value
    from carts
    lateral view explode(attributes) t as key, attr_value
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        src.id,
        src.customer_id,
        src.coupon_codes,
        src.key,
        p.credit_limit,
        p.segment,
        p.country
    from exploded src
    inner join customers p
        on src.customer_id <=> p.id
    where p.age between 41 and 62
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by key order by credit_limit desc, id, key) as latest_rank
        from with_dims
    ) ranked
    where latest_rank = 1
),
with_dims_carts as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        s.*,
        d.city,
        d.name,
        d.age
    from ranked s
    left join customers d
        on s.customer_id = d.id
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        coupon_codes,
        key,
        credit_limit,
        segment,
        country,
        latest_rank,
        city,
        name,
        avg(age) over (partition by segment, key order by age, id, key rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_avg_age,
        sum(age) over (partition by segment, key order by age, id, key rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_sum_age,
        min(age) over (partition by segment, key order by age, id, key rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_min_age
    from with_dims_carts
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        coupon_codes,
        key,
        credit_limit,
        city,
        last_value(city) ignore nulls over (partition by segment, key order by latest_rank, id, key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_city,
        last_value(last4_min_age, true) over (order by last4_min_age, id, key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_last4_min_age,
        lead(credit_limit, 1) over (partition by key order by credit_limit, id, key) as next_credit_limit
    from with_windows
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    case when last_known_last4_min_age >= 66 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as last_known_last4_min_age_tier,
    case when credit_limit >= 16800 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as credit_limit_tier,
    city,
    count(case when key = 'utm_source' then 1 end) as utm_source_count,
    sum(case when city = 'New York' then credit_limit else 0 end) as new_york_credit_limit,
    avg(next_credit_limit) filter (where key = 'weight_kg') as weight_kg_avg_next_credit_limit,
    size(collect_set(key)) as num_keys,
    sum(last_known_last4_min_age) filter (where city = 'Chiang Mai') as chiang_mai_total_last_known_last4_min_age
from metrics
group by cube (case when last_known_last4_min_age >= 66 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end, case when credit_limit >= 16800 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, city)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

exploded = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode("attributes").alias("key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    exploded
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("src.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.age").between(41, 62))
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.customer_id",
        "src.coupon_codes",
        "src.key",
        F.col("p.credit_limit"),
        F.col("p.segment"),
        F.col("p.country"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").desc(), "id", "key")))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_dims_carts = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("d.city"), F.col("d.name"), F.col("d.age"))
)

with_windows = (
    with_dims_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "coupon_codes",
        "key",
        "credit_limit",
        "segment",
        "country",
        "latest_rank",
        "city",
        "name",
        F.avg("age").over(Window.partitionBy("segment", "key").orderBy("age", "id", "key").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_avg_age"),
        F.sum("age").over(Window.partitionBy("segment", "key").orderBy("age", "id", "key").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_sum_age"),
        F.min("age").over(Window.partitionBy("segment", "key").orderBy("age", "id", "key").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)).alias("last4_min_age"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "coupon_codes",
        "key",
        "credit_limit",
        "city",
        F.last("city", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("segment", "key").orderBy("latest_rank", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_city"),
        F.last("last4_min_age", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy("last4_min_age", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("last_known_last4_min_age"),
        F.lead("credit_limit", 1).over(Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("credit_limit", "id", "key")).alias("next_credit_limit"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("last_known_last4_min_age") >= 66, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("last_known_last4_min_age_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("credit_limit") >= 16800, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("credit_limit_tier"),
        "city",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("key") == "utm_source", 1)).alias("utm_source_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "New York", F.col("credit_limit")).otherwise(0)).alias("new_york_credit_limit"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("key") == "weight_kg", F.col("next_credit_limit"))).alias("weight_kg_avg_next_credit_limit"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("key")).alias("num_keys"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "Chiang Mai", F.col("last_known_last4_min_age"))).alias("chiang_mai_total_last_known_last4_min_age"),
    )
)
```

```sql
WITH scoped_events AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor,
        event_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES AS event_at_plus_30m
    FROM ticket_events
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per event_type
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM scoped_events
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR event_at > prev_event_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        event_type,
        session_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY event_type, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    event_type,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    duration_min
FROM sessions
ORDER BY event_type NULLS LAST, session_id
LIMIT 10
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped_events = (
    df_ticket_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "ticket_id",
        "event_at",
        "event_type",
        "actor",
        (F.col("event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 MINUTES")).alias("event_at_plus_30m"),
    )
)

with_prev = scoped_events.withColumn("prev_event_at", F.lag("event_at").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id")))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("starts_session", F.when(F.col("prev_event_at").isNull() | (F.col("event_at") > F.col("prev_event_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("starts_session").over(Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)))

sessions = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("event_type", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.min("event_at").alias("session_start"),
        F.max("event_at").alias("session_end"),
        F.count("*").alias("events"),
        F.round((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("event_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("event_at"))) / 60, 1).alias("duration_min"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions
    .select(
        "event_type",
        "session_id",
        "session_start",
        "duration_min",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("event_type").asc_nulls_last(), "session_id")
    .limit(10)
)
```

```sql
),

        su.tier AS agent_tier
    FROM ranked s

    WHERE su.team NOT IN ('Tech', 'Billing')
),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        requester_id - closed_at_dayofweek AS requester_id_minus_closed_at_dayofweek,
        ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_SORT(tags), ',') AS tags_text
    FROM with_parent_agent

-- Subtotals with CUBE

    SUM(agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek_sum_requester_id) FILTER (WHERE agent_tier IN ('T1', 'T3')) AS agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek_sum_requester_id_ag
```

```python
scoped = (

        "opened_at",
        "priority",
        "channel",
        "tags",
        F.concat_ws(" / ", F.col("priority"), F.col("channel")).alias("priority_channel_label"),
        F.least(F.col("requester_id"), F.col("csat")).alias("least_requester_id_csat"),
        F.dayofweek(F.col("closed_at")).alias("closed_at_dayofweek"),

        F.round(F.col("closed_at_dayofweek") - F.avg("closed_at_dayofweek").over(w_agent_id_closed_at_dayofweek), 2).alias("closed_at_dayofweek_vs_agent_id_closed_at_dayofw"),
```

```sql
),
with_prev AS (
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY site_id ORDER BY read_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session

        SUM(kwh) AS session_kwh,

    FROM sessionized

),
annotated AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN duration_min >= 192.0 THEN 'A' WHEN duration_min >= 48.0 THEN 'B' ELSE 'C' END AS duration_min_tier,

        TO_DATE(session_start) AS session_start_date
    FROM sessions
)
```
